# Testbenches of this corpus that do not yet print what xsim printed,
# each with the reason (`tests/sim_lang_xsim.rs`). A `skip` is not run.
# Reasons that start `refused:` or `line` are what Reticle printed;
# the rest were written by hand.
v/min_1.v line 1: prints `a 0e` where xsim prints `a 1e`
v/min_10.v refused: unsupported construct: `fork` / `join` (no parallel processes in the IR)
v/min_11.v refused: a `real` value has no truth value
v/min_13.v line 1: prints `tb initial` where xsim prints `sub initial`

vhd/min_01.vhd std_logic held in four values: `U`, `X`, `W` and `-` all read as `x` and `H`/`L` as `1`/`0`, where xsim keeps all nine and resolves them by the IEEE 1164 table
vhd/min_56.vhd std_logic held in four values: `U`, `X`, `W` and `-` all read as `x` and `H`/`L` as `1`/`0`, where xsim keeps all nine and resolves them by the IEEE 1164 table
vhd/vh_case.vhd an xsim defect, not copied: an ordinary `case` on a vector matches `"1--"` against `"110"`, as only `case?` may
vhd/vh_case_b.vhd an xsim defect, not copied: an ordinary `case` on a vector matches `"1--"` against `"110"`, as only `case?` may
vhd/vh_delta.vhd a concurrent assignment is a continuous assignment here and settles in the delta its inputs change in; VHDL takes one delta per statement
vhd/vh_enum.vhd an xsim defect, not copied: `'image(maximum(...))` of an enumeration prints one character
vhd/vh_env_stop.vhd `std.env.stop` stops without the line xsim prints, `$stop called at time : 0 fs`
vhd/vh_numeric_arith.vhd an xsim defect, not copied: `boolean'image` of a comparison of arrays prints `tru`/`fal`
vhd/vh_numeric_std_unsigned.vhd an xsim defect, not copied: `boolean'image` of a comparison of arrays prints `tru`/`fal`
vhd/vh_resolution.vhd std_logic held in four values: `U`, `X`, `W` and `-` all read as `x` and `H`/`L` as `1`/`0`, where xsim keeps all nine and resolves them by the IEEE 1164 table
vhd/vh_resolution_const.vhd std_logic held in four values: `U`, `X`, `W` and `-` all read as `x` and `H`/`L` as `1`/`0`, where xsim keeps all nine and resolves them by the IEEE 1164 table
vhd/vh_resolution_const_b.vhd std_logic held in four values: `U`, `X`, `W` and `-` all read as `x` and `H`/`L` as `1`/`0`, where xsim keeps all nine and resolves them by the IEEE 1164 table
vhd/vh_slv_ops.vhd an xsim defect, not copied: `boolean'image` of a comparison of arrays prints `tru`/`fal`
vhd/vh_strings.vhd an xsim defect, not copied: `boolean'image` of a comparison of arrays prints `tru`/`fal`
vhd/vh_time.vhd `time'pos` counts femtoseconds here, where xsim counts picoseconds, its resolution
